in_marathi.name: Deval
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deval हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deval is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'deva' which means 'god' or 'deity'. In Hinduism, Deval is often referred to as the lord of the gods, representing power, strength, and protection.
